verdict.rationale: First-party docs publish a headline coverage number: users can search 'more than 12,000 supported banks'. Geography appears only in community comments, which say it is US-only, not in any first-party coverage page. Missing for 10: first-party published geographies/country list, a checkable per-institution coverage list or search tool, breakdown by institution type (e.g., commercial vs. retail), independent corroboration of the 12,000 figure.
